investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ardgate Assurance (insurance); Platform: Google Cloud us-east4 (zones us-east4-a/us-east4-b/us-east4-c); network range 10.91.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ardgat-prod-useast (GKE); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic claims-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer claims-api, consumer documents-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
